subject: Re: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit contribution
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@hackfest.org>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit ask

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the quick chat yesterday. HackFest runs June 10–12 and this year we're expanding the mentor program: 120 mentors, ~40 maintainers/mentors from OSS projects, and a small set of judged demos that will need access to reliable inference for the weekend.

We had Redwood on our wishlist for credits to provide mentors and maintainers with short-term access (2 week trial extensions + 2k token credits per mentor) and some host-level quota for demo teams (burstable access during demo windows). Can you share what level of promotional credits / trial extension you could consider? We're flexible on branding and will surface Redwood in the mentor communications + a small sponsor banner.

Attached is the sponsorship proposal and a provisional mentor roster. Happy to jump on a 20 minute call if helpful.

Best,
Samira
Director, Partnerships — HackFest

Attachments: HackFest_Sponsorship_Proposal_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Mentor_Roster_2027.csv (text/csv)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@hackfest.org>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit ask

Samira — thanks for the details and the packet, looks like a great event. Looping in Rishi (community programs) and Laura (partnerships) to evaluate scope. A few quick clarifying Qs to help us propose something actionable: 

- Is the mentor cohort already finalized? The roster shows ~120 names but a subset will be mentors that actually need compute.
- For the demo teams, how many concurrent demos do you expect during the demo block (so we can size burst capacity)?
- Do you need private data handling / VPC access for any mentor/maintainer use-cases?

If it's easier, Rishi and I can propose a modest credits package + a time-limited trial extension and an on-call support window during the weekend. Rishi — what's our typical allotment for community partner mentor programs this scale?

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Community Programs, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit ask

Quick take: for 100-ish active mentor accounts we usually offer either (A) 1000 token credits per mentor + a 14 day trial extension, or (B) a shared pool (200k tokens) with per-team caps and an on-call Slack channel. For demo-day burst, we can enable a 10x burst window for up to 6 concurrent sessions for a 3 hour block.

We should tie the package to visibility: sponsor mention in mentor comms + a short 'how to get credits' page. Also recommend a small follow-up survey to capture retention signals.

I'd propose option B for HackFest (shared pool + burst) — simpler to manage operationally and easier to set up in Dedicated for short windows. Estimated list price impact: equivalent to about $4k in hosted usage (we can convert to a promotional coupon).

Laura — can partnerships OK a $4k promo allowance for HackFest + comms/landing page support?

— Rishi
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit ask

Thanks Rishi — $4k seems reasonable given the reach and the sponsor placement. Two notes:

1) I want the marketing team to approve the exact wording of the mentor comms before we commit; don't want inadvertent product promises.
2) Please confirm terms: 14 day trial extension for new accounts + 200k shared pool coupon for demo/test usage, with a one-time 3-hour burst window (6 concurrent). If HackFest will display our logo we should have co-marketing guidelines on file (I can share).

If everyone agrees, I'll approve the promo and set the HubSpot deal to HS:00091234 and draft the promo coupon. Aditya — can you confirm the mentor communication cadence so we can sync marketing?

— Laura
From: Samira Khan <samira@hackfest.org>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: orgs@hackfest.org
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackFest 2027 — mentor compute / credit ask

Amazing — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the package. Confirming HackFest accepts option B: shared pool + burst window, and we will feature Redwood on the mentor comms and sponsor page. Marketing will send final copy for approval by May 6. Could we aim to have the coupon live by May 10 so mentors can redeem ahead of the event?

Thanks so much — Samira
Director, Partnerships — HackFest
